2125329953617248371.en_summary: Deel is using Stripe's global stablecoin cards to help contractors spend their earnings around the world. Quoted Deel announcing new Deel Card for spending DLUSD anywhere Visa is accepted with up to 1.5% cashback.
2125329953617248371.zh_summary: Deel正在使用Stripe的全球穩定幣卡，幫助承包商在世界各地消費其收入。引用Deel宣布新的Deel Card，可在Visa接受的任何地方消費DLUSD，最高1.5%現金回饋。

2125329743990198433.en_summary: Gary Marcus mocks people who fell for a scam, warning them earlier. Quoted zerohedge on updating the performance table for ANT's post-IPO plunge which was 10x-20x oversubscribed.

2125424688960581809.en_summary: Brad Setser notes US tariffs are currently below the caps agreed at Busan. Suspects this raises them back to that limit. Restoring the negotiated tariff levels is the goal, achieved via different legal means.
2125424688960581809.zh_summary: Brad Setser指出美國關稅目前低於釜山協議的上限。他懷疑這會將關稅重新提高到該限額。恢復談判達成的關稅水平是目標，透過不同的法律手段實現。

2125420613531501033.en_summary: (Reposted by @jasonfurman) Analysts who map the CPI and PPI into the PCE expect overall prices rose 3.8% in October from a year earlier, with core prices up 3.2% (0.29% on the month). With that reading nine of the last 12 months would show core prices rising at least 0.26%.
2125420613531501033.zh_summary: (由@jasonfurman轉推) 將CPI和PPI映射到PCE的分析師預計10月整體價格同比上漲3.8%，核心價格上漲3.2%（月環比0.29%）。按照這個讀數，過去12個月中有9個月核心價格至少上漲0.26%。
